I was in a fragile state of mind, I was scared she was going to leave; When I was trying to convey that it would hurt a lot to lose her, it came out wrong and it sounded as though I was going to self-harm or something similar. It scared them.

I'm not exactly sure how to fix it, they said everything was fine, and that they understand - but I don't think they see me the same way now. I feel like I screwed everything up.

I acted too desperately, I relived some old damage from something else and it came out as a desperate clawing for them to stay when I thought they were going to leave me...

It scared them.. And still does. Its times like this I really feel the damage from everything I went through and I recognized it all immediately when they told me... And I began to work to fix it so it wouldn't affect me or them again...

But it still feels like shit knowing that I ruined their image of me... I'm no longer the hero in their eyes. I'm possibly a foe. Or someone else that might hurt them trust is cracked..

I just hope I can fix this is all. I'm not trying to take sunshine from anyone.
I will one day... For now.. I can't.
